note: Heading of the staff sign-in page.

sw: Konsoli ya wafanyakazi ya Olink Desk
note: Line under the sign-in heading. 'Olink Desk' is a product name — keep it.
Form label: the organization's short identifier used to sign in.

en: Your workspace's short name — for example demo
am: የሥራ ቦታዎ አጭር ስም — ለምሳሌ demo
om: Maqaa gabaabaa iddoo hojii keessanii — fakkeenyaaf demo
ti: ሓጺር ስም ናይ ስራሕ ቦታኹም — ንኣብነት demo
so: Magaca gaaban ee goobta shaqadaada — tusaale demo
sw: Jina fupi la eneo lako la kazi — kwa mfano demo
note: Help text under the workspace field. 'demo' is a literal example value — keep it.
Form label for the email field.
Form label for the password field.
The sign-in button.
Button text while the sign-in request is running.

am: የሥራ ቦታ፣ ኢሜይል ወይም የይለፍ ቃል ተሳስቷል።
om: Iddoon hojii, imeeliin yookaan jechi darbii dogoggora.
ti: ናይ ስራሕ ቦታ፣ ኢመይል ወይ መሕለፊ ቃል ተጋግዩ እዩ።
so: Goobta shaqada, iimaylka ama erayga sirta ah waa khalad.
sw: Eneo la kazi, barua pepe au nenosiri si sahihi.
note: Error when workspace/email/password do not match. Deliberately does not say which was wrong.

en: Too many attempts — try again in a few minutes.
am: ብዙ ሙከራዎች ነበሩ — ከጥቂት ደቂቃዎች በኋላ ይሞክሩ።
om: Yaaliin baay'een tureera — daqiiqaa muraasa booda irra deebi'aa yaalaa.
ti: ብዙሕ ፈተነታት ነይሩ — ድሕሪ ቁሩብ ደቓይቕ ፈትኑ።
so: Isku dayo badan ayaa dhacay — dhawr daqiiqo ka dib isku day.
sw: Majaribio mengi mno — jaribu tena baada ya dakika chache.
note: Error after repeated failed sign-ins; the account unlocks by itself.
The sign-out button in the console header.
Heading of the Channels page (Telegram, WhatsApp, SMS…).
Line under the Channels heading. {org} is the organization's name.
Shown while a page or card is fetching data.
Badge on a channel that is connected and working.
Badge on a channel that is built but not yet connected.
Heading of the list of things required to connect a channel.
Label of the input where the admin pastes the Telegram bot token. @BotFather is Telegram's official bot — keep the name.
Button that saves the pasted token and registers the webhook.
Button text while connecting.
Success line. {bot} is the bot's Telegram username, shown as @name.

en: Pasting a new token replaces the current connection. If you revoke the token in BotFather, paste the new one here straight away.
am: አዲስ ቶክን መለጠፍ አሁን ያለውን ግንኙነት ይተካል። በBotFather ቶክኑን ከሰረዙ አዲሱን ወዲያውኑ እዚህ ይለጥፉ።
om: Tookinii haaraa maxxansuun walqabsiisa ammaa bakka bu'a. BotFather keessatti tookinii yoo haqxan, isa haaraa battalumatti asitti maxxansaa.
ti: ሓድሽ ቶክን ምልጣፍ ነቲ ዘሎ ርክብ ይትክኦ። ኣብ BotFather ቶክን እንተሰሪዝኩም፣ ነቲ ሓድሽ ብቕጽበት ኣብዚ ለጥፉዎ።
so: Ku dhejinta tookin cusub waxay beddeshaa xiriirka hadda jira. Haddii aad tookinka ka burisid BotFather, kan cusub isla markiiba halkan ku dheji.
sw: Kubandika tokeni mpya hubadilisha muunganisho wa sasa. Ukifuta tokeni katika BotFather, bandika mpya hapa mara moja.
note: Help text: pasting a new token replaces the old one, and a token revoked in BotFather must be re-pasted. 'Revoke' is BotFather's own action name.

en: The stored token no longer works — it was revoked in BotFather. Paste the current token to reconnect.
am: የተቀመጠው ቶክን ከአሁን በኋላ አይሰራም — በBotFather ተሰርዟል። ለመገናኘት አሁን ያለውን ቶክን ይለጥፉ።
om: Tookiniin kuufame kana booda hin hojjetu — BotFather keessatti haqameera. Walqabsiisuuf tookinii ammaa maxxansaa.
ti: እቲ ዝተቐመጠ ቶክን ደጊም ኣይሰርሕን እዩ — ኣብ BotFather ተሰሪዙ እዩ። ንምርኻብ ነቲ ሕጂ ዘሎ ቶክን ለጥፉ።
so: Tookinka kaydsan hadda ma shaqeeyo — waxaa laga buriyay BotFather. Si aad dib ugu xirto, ku dheji tookinka hadda jira.
sw: Tokeni iliyohifadhiwa haifanyi kazi tena — ilifutwa katika BotFather. Bandika tokeni ya sasa ili kuunganisha upya.
note: Warning when the saved token no longer works because it was revoked. Tells the admin the one action that fixes it.
Status line: Telegram has our webhook registered. 'Webhook' is a technical term — keep it.

en: Telegram is pointing somewhere else — paste the token again to fix it.
am: Telegram ወደ ሌላ ቦታ እያመለከተ ነው — ለማስተካከል ቶክኑን እንደገና ይለጥፉ።
om: Telegram bakka biraa agarsiisaa jira — sirreessuuf tookinii irra deebi'aa maxxansaa.
ti: Telegram ናብ ካልእ ቦታ የመልክት ኣሎ — ንምእራም ነቲ ቶክን ደጊምኩም ለጥፉ።
so: Telegram meel kale ayuu tilmaamayaa — si aad u saxdo, tookinka mar kale ku dheji.
sw: Telegram inaelekeza mahali pengine — bandika tokeni tena ili kurekebisha.
note: Warning: Telegram is registered to a different address; re-pasting the token repairs it.

ti: ናይ Telegram ናይ መወዳእታ ናይ ምልኣኽ ጌጋ: {error}
sw: Hitilafu ya mwisho ya utumaji ya Telegram: {error}
note: Shows Telegram's own most recent delivery error. {error} is the raw message from Telegram, usually English.
Error when the connect attempt is rejected. {error} is the reason.
Status line for a channel with nothing connected yet.
Shown when the console could not reach Telegram to check. {error} is the reason.
Heading of the create-a-workspace (organization sign-up) page.
Form label: the organization's full display name.
Form label: the registering person's own name.
The create-workspace button.
Button text while the workspace is being created.
Error when creation is rejected (taken slug, weak password…). {error} is the reason from the server, usually English.

en: Already have a workspace? Sign in
ti: ናይ ስራሕ ቦታ ኣለኩም ድዩ? እተዉ
note: Link from the register page to the sign-in page.

ti: ሓድሽ ዲኹም? ናይ ስራሕ ቦታ ፍጠሩ
so: Ma cusub tahay? Samee goobta shaqada
note: Link from the sign-in page to the register page.
Sidebar navigation item: the overview screen with today's numbers.
Sidebar navigation item: the list of customer tickets.
Stat tile label: tickets currently open (new + open + waiting).
Stat tile label: tickets opened today.
Stat tile label: open tickets no agent has replied to yet.
Card heading: count of tickets per channel (Telegram, SMS…).
Card heading: the most recently active tickets.

en: No tickets yet. Connect a channel and incoming messages become tickets here.
am: እስካሁን ቲኬቶች የሉም። ቻናል ያገናኙ — የሚገቡ መልዕክቶች እዚህ ቲኬቶች ይሆናሉ።
om: Ammatti tiikeetiin hin jiru. Chaanaalii walqabsiisaa — ergaawwan dhufan asitti tiikeetii ta'u.
ti: ክሳብ ሕጂ ቲኬታት የለዉን። ቻናል ኣራኽቡ — ዝኣትዉ መልእኽትታት ኣብዚ ቲኬታት ይኾኑ።
so: Weli tikidho ma jiraan. Ku xir kanaal — fariimaha soo galaa halkan tikidho ayay noqdaan.
sw: Bado hakuna tiketi. Unganisha njia — jumbe zinazoingia huwa tiketi hapa.
note: Empty state of the dashboard/inbox before any customer has written.

om: Mul'ata kana keessa tiikeetiin hin jiru.
note: Empty state of the inbox when a status filter matches nothing.

en: Select a ticket to read it.
so: Dooro tikidh si aad u akhrido.
note: Right pane placeholder before a ticket is selected.
Placeholder inside the reply box.
The send-reply button.
Send button while the reply is being delivered.
Error when a reply could not be delivered. {error} is the reason.
Inbox filter chip meaning no status filter.
Ticket status: just arrived, unhandled.
Ticket status: an agent is on it.
Ticket status: waiting for the customer to answer.
Ticket status: solved, pending closure.
Ticket status: finished.
Label for the customer side of a conversation timeline.
Back button from a ticket's conversation to the ticket list (mobile).

en: Send us a message — our team replies right here.
om: Ergaa keessan nuuf ergaa — gareen keenya asuma deebii isiniif kenna.
ti: መልእኽትኹም ስደዱልና — ጋንታና ኣብዚ ክምልሰልኩም እዩ።
so: Fariintaada noo soo dir — kooxdayadu halkan ayay kaaga jawaabi doontaa.
sw: Tutumie ujumbe wako — timu yetu itakujibu hapa hapa.
note: CUSTOMER-FACING (widget): the line shown before the visitor's first message.
CUSTOMER-FACING (widget): placeholder in the message box.

en: Could not send — check your connection and try again.
am: መላክ አልተቻለም — ግንኙነትዎን ያረጋግጡና እንደገና ይሞክሩ።
om: Erguun hin danda'amne — walqunnamtii keessan mirkaneessaa irra deebi'aa yaalaa.
ti: ምስዳድ ኣይተኻእለን — ርክብኩም ኣረጋግጹን ደጊምኩም ፈትኑን።
so: Lama diri karin — hubi xiriirkaaga oo mar kale isku day.
sw: Imeshindwa kutuma — angalia muunganisho wako kisha ujaribu tena.
note: CUSTOMER-FACING (widget): error when a message could not be sent.
CUSTOMER-FACING (widget): footer credit line. 'Olink Desk' is the product name — keep it.
Channels page: heading of the website-widget embed card.

en: Paste this snippet before </body> on any page of your site.
am: ይህን ኮድ በማንኛውም የድህረ ገጽዎ ገጽ ላይ ከ</body> በፊት ይለጥፉ።
om: Koodii kana fuula weebsaayitii keessanii kamiyyuu irratti </body> dura maxxansaa.
ti: ነዚ ኮድ ኣብ ዝኾነ ገጽ ወብሳይትኩም ቅድሚ </body> ለጥፉዎ።
so: Koodhkan ku dheji bog kasta oo websaydkaaga ah </body> ka hor.
sw: Bandika msimbo huu kwenye ukurasa wowote wa tovuti yako kabla ya </body>.
note: Channels page: how to install the snippet. '</body>' is an HTML tag — keep it exactly.
Button that copies the embed snippet.
Copy button after a successful copy.
Link that opens the org's widget page in a new tab.
Ticket rail label: the ticket's status field.
Ticket rail label: the ticket's priority field.
Ticket rail label: the agent responsible for the ticket.
Button: assign the ticket to the signed-in agent.
Shown where no agent is assigned (rail and wallboard).
Ticket rail label: the queue (named work bucket) the ticket sits in.
Shown when a ticket is in no queue.
Placeholder of the create-a-queue input.
Button that creates the queue.
Priority level: lowest.
Priority level: default.
Priority level: elevated.
Priority level: highest — tightest SLA clock.
SLA chip: time remaining to send the first reply. {t} is a duration like '2h 15m'.
SLA chip: time remaining to resolve. {t} is a duration.
SLA chip: the promise was missed. {t} is how late.
SLA chip: the first reply went out inside the target.
Sidebar item: the supervisor's live overview screen (for a big monitor).
Wallboard stat: open tickets right now.
Wallboard stat: tickets past 80% of their SLA window.
Wallboard stat: tickets past their SLA due time.
Wallboard stat: tickets opened today.
Wallboard column: the longest a ticket has been waiting.
Wallboard section: staff and their open assignment counts.

sw: Wastani wa jibu la kwanza leo
note: Wallboard stat: median minutes to first reply, today.
Wallboard stat: median minutes to resolution, today.
Heading of the saved-views rail in the workspace.
Saved view: open tickets assigned to the signed-in agent.
Saved view: open tickets nobody owns yet.
Saved view: every open ticket in the workspace.
Saved view: tickets recently resolved or closed.
Saved view: no filter at all, every ticket ever.
Placeholder of the workspace search box.
Filter label: which channel a ticket arrived on.
Channel filter option meaning no channel filter.
Assignee filter option meaning any agent (no filter).
Live count beside the Inbox heading. {n} is a number.
Shown when the result set is larger than one page. {n} is a number.

en: Nothing assigned to you. Work you take will appear here.
am: ለእርስዎ የተመደበ ነገር የለም። የሚይዙት ሥራ እዚህ ይታያል።
om: Wanti isiniif ramadame hin jiru. Hojiin isin fudhattan asitti mul'ata.
ti: ንዓኹም ዝተመደበ የለን። እትወስድዎ ስራሕ ኣብዚ ክርአ እዩ።
so: Waxba lagugu ma xilsaarin. Shaqada aad qaadato halkan ayay ka muuqan doontaa.
sw: Hakuna ulichokabidhiwa. Kazi utakayochukua itaonekana hapa.
note: Empty state of the My-work view — encouraging, not an error.

en: Nothing waiting — every open ticket has an owner.
am: የሚጠብቅ የለም — ሁሉም ክፍት ቲኬት ባለቤት አለው።
om: Wanti eegaa jiru hin jiru — tiikeetiin banaa hundi abbaa qaba.
ti: ዝጽበ የለን — ኩሉ ክፉት ቲኬት ወናኒ ኣለዎ።
so: Waxba ma sugayaan — tikidh kasta oo furan wuxuu leeyahay qof.
sw: Hakuna inayosubiri — kila tiketi iliyo wazi ina mwenyewe.
note: Empty state of the Unassigned view: good news, everything has an owner.
Empty state of the Recently-solved view.

am: ከዚህ ፍለጋ ጋር የሚዛመድ ቲኬት የለም።
om: Barbaacha kanaan tiikeetiin wal hin simu.
so: Tikidh la mid ah raadintaas ma jiro.
sw: Hakuna tiketi inayolingana na utafutaji huo.
note: Empty state when a search matches nothing.
Heading of the customer section in the right context rail.
Heading of the ticket section in the right context rail.
Context rail field: when the ticket was opened.
Context rail field: the conversation's language.
Context rail field: the customer's phone number.
Button that clears the active list filters.
